item.title: Bangladesh Hindus Fear Genocidal Attacks Ahead of February Election
item.description: Allegations are that a plan has been hatched to kill two lakh Hindus and Buddhists in Chittagong’s Raozan sub-district. The post Bangladesh Hindus Fear Genocidal Attacks Ahead of February Election appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Bangladesh: A Raging Inferno in India’s Neighbourhood
item.description: The killing of so called student leaders Hadi or Sikdar may be the tipping point, but the larger question is who benefits from their deaths. The post Bangladesh: A Raging Inferno in India’s Neighbourhood appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Operation Sentinel: Proof that India needs a unified cyber strike force now
item.description: What INTERPOL achieved in Africa was transforming scattered partnerships into operational backbones. For a nation confronting everything from deepfake sextortion to large-scale mule-account networks, that structured cooperation has become indispensable rather than optional The post Operation Sentinel: Proof that India needs a unified cyber strike force now appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: How China is establishing dominance in shipbuilding
item.description: China builds a frigate every 25 months and a destroyer every 2.5 years. China’s capacity to replace and maintain naval ships outpaces that of any country in the world. It also owns the largest fleet of oceangoing commercial ships, including ships registered in third countries. The post How China is establishing dominance in shipbuilding appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: U.S.-Palau agreement shows new National Security Strategy in action
item.description: One of the new agreements with the United States is designed to help counter Chinese political warfare attacks on Palau. The initial cost to the United States is $2.2 million, exactly the sort of low-cost counter to China’s ability to disrupt and degrade the economy, politics and society of a key U.S. ally that is needed. The post U.S.-Palau agreement shows new National Security Strategy in action appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Have been fighting against the communal forces for 50 years: Digvijaya
